verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of a point-of-sale (POS) product or integration for WooCommerce — no in-person checkout, POS hardware, or unified in-store/online inventory syncing is documented anywhere in the docs, marketplace, or API references. While multi-channel selling is a fair axis for an e-commerce platform, WooCommerce's evidence only covers online store features (payments, shipping, REST API, mobile app for managing the online store) with no POS capability shown.
